mapper.select: SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude FROM weather_area ORDER BY power(latitude - #{lat}, 2) + power(longitude - #{lng}, 2) LIMIT 1

SELECT target_at, condition, temperature_c, humidity_pct, rainfall_mm, precipitation_prob FROM weather_hourly WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND is_forecast = FALSE AND target_at <= NOW() ORDER BY target_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT target_at, condition, temperature_c, humidity_pct, rainfall_mm, precipitation_prob FROM weather_hourly WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND is_forecast = TRUE AND target_at > NOW() ORDER BY target_at LIMIT #{limit}

WITH u AS ( SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude FROM underpass WHERE id = #{underpassId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ), a AS ( SELECT wa.id, wa.name FROM weather_area wa, u ORDER BY power(wa.latitude - u.latitude, 2) + power(wa.longitude - u.longitude, 2) LIMIT 1 ), latest AS ( SELECT MAX(h.target_at) AS t FROM weather_hourly h, a WHERE h.area_id = a.id AND h.is_forecast = FALSE AND h.target_at <= NOW() ) SELECT u.id AS underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, a.name AS area_name, l.t AS observed_at, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm) FILTER (WHERE h.target_at = l.t), 0) AS rainfall_mm, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm) FILTER (WHERE h.target_at = l.t - interval '1 hour'), 0) AS rainfall1h_mm, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm) FILTER (WHERE h.target_at > l.t - interval '3 hours'), 0) AS rainfall3h_mm, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm) FILTER (WHERE h.target_at > l.t - interval '6 hours'), 0) AS rainfall6h_mm, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm) FILTER (WHERE h.target_at > l.t - interval '12 hours'), 0) AS rainfall12h_mm, COALESCE(SUM(h.rainfall_mm), 0) AS rainfall24h_mm FROM u CROSS JOIN a CROSS JOIN latest l LEFT JOIN weather_hourly h ON h.area_id = a.id AND h.is_forecast = FALSE AND h.target_at <= l.t AND h.target_at > l.t - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY u.id, u.name, a.name, l.t

SELECT target_at::date AS forecast_date, MIN(temperature_c) AS min_temperature, MAX(temperature_c) AS max_temperature, MAX(precipitation_prob) AS precipitation_prob FROM weather_hourly WHERE area_id = #{areaId} AND is_forecast = TRUE GROUP BY target_at::date ORDER BY forecast_date LIMIT #{limit}
